Concrete solutions & planning prices

A catalog of the concrete work we offer, with regional price ranges to help you plan a budget before your estimate.

Concrete solutions catalog

Concrete work is built to order for each property, so nothing here is sold online. These ranges are per square foot and are meant for early planning; your project-specific estimate will reflect your site.

  • Standard Concrete Driveway

    Poured concrete driveway on an excavated, compacted gravel base, with a broom finish for traction and planned slope for drainage.

    Typical uses: new driveways, full replacements, widening an existing drive.

    $7–$12per sq. ft.
    planning estimate

  • Standard Concrete Patio

    A broom or smooth-finished patio slab for dining, grilling, and outdoor seating, sloped away from the house.

    Typical uses: backyard patios, side-yard sitting areas, grill pads.

    $7–$12per sq. ft.
    planning estimate

  • Stamped Concrete

    Concrete pressed with a pattern and colored to resemble stone, slate, or brick. Requires more labor and materials than a standard finish. Availability depends on the project.

    Typical uses: decorative patios, entry walks, pool surrounds.

    $12–$18per sq. ft.
    planning estimate

  • Concrete Sidewalk

    Walkways and sidewalk sections, straight or curved. Narrow layouts and curves mean more forming per square foot, which is why the range is wider.

    Typical uses: front entry paths, garden walks, sidewalk replacement.

    $8–$15per sq. ft.
    planning estimate

  • Standard Concrete Slab

    A level, general-purpose slab or pad built to the dimensions of the building or equipment it will support.

    Typical uses: shed and storage-building pads, HVAC and generator pads, utility slabs.

    $6–$12per sq. ft.
    planning estimate

  • Garage Concrete Floor

    Interior garage slab with reinforcement and joint layout planned for vehicles, finished smooth and even.

    Typical uses: new garage slabs, replacing a failed garage floor.

    $7–$12per sq. ft.
    planning estimate

  • Concrete Removal

    Breaking out and hauling away existing concrete so the area can be prepared for new work.

    Typical uses: before a driveway, patio, or sidewalk replacement.

    $2–$5per sq. ft.
    planning estimate

What determines your final cost

Two driveways of the same size can be priced very differently. These are the factors we review on site before preparing your estimate.

  • Project dimensions
  • Excavation
  • Soil conditions
  • Gravel base preparation
  • Reinforcement
  • Concrete thickness
  • Accessibility
  • Concrete volume
  • Existing concrete removal
  • Finishing requirements
  • Permits and local requirements

About these prices

All prices shown are general planning estimates based on regional market information. They are not guaranteed prices or formal quotations from Set Right Flatwork LLC. Final pricing is determined after reviewing project requirements and site conditions.
